truth_boundaries: GitHub Pages is the formal public static deployment, not an OpenAI Sites preview.
Pages uses browser-local BYOK and direct model requests; endpoint CORS policy still determines whether a chosen service can be called from the Pages origin.
The external catalog only registers disabled metadata; third-party Skill and MCP execution is not implemented.
Local provider mock tests verify protocol translation, not live provider availability, latency or billing behavior.
Repository CI and this evidence file are maintainer-run checks, not independent third-party validation.
Metrics are point-in-time facts and must be refreshed before an application is submitted.
This file records verified evidence and is not an acceptance or program-eligibility claim.
